tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Identity. Morning mist between the trees: the page ground by day (`surface`).

tokens.name: firn
tokens.usage: Identity. First snow on the peaks above the forest: raised panels by day (`surface-raised`).

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: Identity. Pale lichen on granite: sunken fields, control tracks and the land on maps by day.

tokens.name: larch
tokens.usage: Identity. THE Larch colour: larch needles in late October. The action fill (`accent`), the selected economy, the trail marker. `spruce` text on it (7.6:1 by day). Never text on `mist`.

tokens.name: resin
tokens.usage: Identity. Larch resin: the text-safe gold for kickers, stage numerals and the emphasised series. 5.6:1 on `mist` by day, 9.9:1 on `spruce-night`.

tokens.name: spruce
tokens.usage: Identity. Spruce and stone pine, nearly black: ink by day and the text on every gold fill.

tokens.name: spruce-night
tokens.usage: Identity. The forest at dusk: the page ground by night.

tokens.name: canopy-green
tokens.usage: Identity. Under the canopy: the deep block behind trail heads and the download band, in both themes.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Identity. Moss on the north side of the trunk: links and the focus ring by day (`link`).

tokens.name: rowan-red
tokens.usage: Identity. Rowan berries: the one red in the forest. Chokepoints, and the editor's voice. One per screen.

tokens.name: granite
tokens.usage: Identity. Granite boulders on the path: control borders (`line-strong`).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground and the map's sea. Text: `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels that sit over the map (filter rail, drawer, tooltip), cards and tables.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Control tracks (segmented control, slider), code chips, the time strip.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative only, never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and the time strip; 3.2:1 on `surface` by day, 4.4:1 by night.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` (13.7:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Deks, labels, legend text, table headers. 8.0:1 on `surface` by day, 10.1:1 by night.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, axis ticks, source lines, the HS chapter name. 5.1:1 on `surface-sunk` by day; 6.2:1 on `surface-raised` by night.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The only action fill: primary Button, selected segment, play button, the selected economy's node. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` (6.4:1 with `on-accent` by day).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover`, and on Signposts.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, active tab labels, the selected row's marker. 6.4:1 on `surface` by day, 10.3:1 by night.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element; at least 6:1 on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: resin-text
tokens.usage: Kickers, stage numerals (S1–S5), the emphasised value in a tooltip.

tokens.name: rowan
tokens.usage: The chokepoint ring on a node, the chokepoint stage on a trail, the editor's Insight label. 5.7:1 on `surface` by day.

tokens.name: rowan-soft
tokens.usage: `<mark>` highlight and the ground of a chokepoint callout; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: canopy
tokens.usage: The TrailHead band and the download band. Everything on it uses `on-canopy`, `on-canopy-muted`, `canopy-accent`, `canopy-line`.

tokens.name: on-canopy
tokens.usage: Text on `canopy` (10.8:1).

tokens.name: on-canopy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `canopy` (7.0:1).

tokens.name: canopy-accent
tokens.usage: The gold on a canopy block: the stage diamonds and the one button there (6.3:1 on `canopy`).

tokens.name: canopy-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on `canopy`.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land on the network map. Labels on land use `ink` / `ink-muted` (4.9:1 by day).

tokens.name: map-border
tokens.usage: Country borders: a 0.75px cut in the ground colour, as on a topographic sheet.

tokens.name: map-contour
tokens.usage: Graticule and contour hairlines on the map frame; decorative only.

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: Default node fill. 3.4:1 on `map-land` by day, 3.1:1 by night. Every node carries a 1.5px `node-ring`.

tokens.name: node-ring
tokens.usage: The ring that separates overlapping nodes; always the ground colour.

tokens.name: node-selected
tokens.usage: The focus economy's node, with a 2px `ink` outer ring.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Default flow line, drawn at `opacity-edge`. Width encodes value.

tokens.name: flow-out
tokens.usage: The focus economy's exports (its outgoing flows) and their legend key.

tokens.name: flow-in
tokens.usage: The focus economy's imports (incoming flows) and their legend key. Told apart from `flow-out` by lightness and hue, and by the arrowhead.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: State only: data complete, check passed. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: State only: partial year, provisional data, code split between HS versions.

tokens.name: status-serious
tokens.usage: State only: large mirror gap, unit values out of range.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: State only: failed load, missing reporter. Same hue as `rowan`; never both on one element.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Slot 1, larch gold. The first series and group A on the map. Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Slot 2, lichen teal. Group B on the map. Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Slot 3, gentian violet. Group C on the map: slots 1–3 pass the all-pairs check, so a map or scatter colours at most three groups. Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Slot 4, rowan red. Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Slot 5, alpine sky blue. Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-6
tokens.usage: Slot 6, moss green. Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-7
tokens.usage: Slot 7, heather. Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-8
tokens.usage: Slot 8, larch bark. The ceiling; a ninth series folds into Other (`viz-context`). Fixed order, never cycled or re-ranked.

tokens.name: viz-focus
tokens.usage: Emphasis: the series or economy the story is about. Everything else is `viz-context`.

tokens.name: viz-context
tokens.usage: Context series, Other, and countries outside every group.

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal gridlines, 1px solid.

tokens.name: viz-axis
tokens.usage: The zero line and the time-strip baseline.

tokens.name: viz-band
tokens.usage: Shaded periods: incomplete years after the last complete period, recessions.

tokens.name: stage-1
tokens.usage: The first rung of a chain's ladder (ore, crude, raw fibre — the roots). Ordinal ramp (one hue, monotone lightness; light end 2.1:1 by day); ladders of five rungs or fewer take these five tokens spread over the ramp, longer ladders interpolate between stage-1 and stage-5 (larch.css, --stage-k-of-n). Always with the S-number beside it.

tokens.name: stage-2
tokens.usage: S2 primary: refined or smelted material — the trunk. Ordinal ramp (one hue, monotone lightness; light end 2.1:1 by day). Always with the S-number beside it.

tokens.name: stage-3
tokens.usage: S3 material: engineered material — the branches. Ordinal ramp (one hue, monotone lightness; light end 2.1:1 by day). Always with the S-number beside it.

tokens.name: stage-4
tokens.usage: S4 component — the twigs. Ordinal ramp (one hue, monotone lightness; light end 2.1:1 by day). Always with the S-number beside it.

tokens.name: stage-5
tokens.usage: The last rung of a chain's ladder (the product a firm or household buys — the crown). Ordinal ramp (one hue, monotone lightness; light end 2.1:1 by day); the other end of the interpolation for ladders longer than five. Always with the S-number beside it.

tokens.name: seq-100
tokens.usage: Lowest bin; fills only (choropleth, heat cells), never a thin mark.

tokens.name: seq-200
tokens.usage: Sequential step: from a clearing to dense forest. One hue; the anchor flips by night (low = dark).

tokens.name: seq-300
tokens.usage: Lightest step for ordered marks.

tokens.name: seq-400
tokens.usage: Sequential step: from a clearing to dense forest. One hue; the anchor flips by night (low = dark).

tokens.name: seq-500
tokens.usage: Sequential step: from a clearing to dense forest. One hue; the anchor flips by night (low = dark).

tokens.name: seq-600
tokens.usage: Sequential step: from a clearing to dense forest. One hue; the anchor flips by night (low = dark).

tokens.name: seq-700
tokens.usage: Highest bin: dense spruce.

tokens.name: div-neg-3
tokens.usage: Fell most vs the base period (beech-leaf rust). Change colouring (t vs base) on nodes and flows; equal steps per arm.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Fell. Change colouring (t vs base) on nodes and flows; equal steps per arm.

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Fell a little. Change colouring (t vs base) on nodes and flows; equal steps per arm.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: No change (±10% by default). Granite grey, no hue. Change colouring (t vs base) on nodes and flows; equal steps per arm.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Grew a little. Change colouring (t vs base) on nodes and flows; equal steps per arm.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Grew. Change colouring (t vs base) on nodes and flows; equal steps per arm.

tokens.name: div-pos-3
tokens.usage: Grew most vs the base period (alpine sky). Change colouring (t vs base) on nodes and flows; equal steps per arm.

tokens.name: delta-good
tokens.usage: A change that is good for the reader, with ▲/▼ and a sign.

tokens.name: delta-bad
tokens.usage: A change that is bad for the reader, with ▲/▼ and a sign.
